Use case: precise-object-edit.
Revise the supplied seed token study into ONE final token design, not a comparison sheet. Keep ONLY the rounded triangular silhouette shown at the left of the reference; remove the other two shapes. Keep the same bold simple cartoon illustration of three golden seeds and the same physical cardboard cut edge.
Make the SEED CATEGORY COLOUR unmistakable: the whole token face is a rich saturated pumpkin orange, with an extra thick darker burnt-orange printed rim and a slim cream cardboard cut edge outside it. The three illustrated seeds remain bright golden yellow with dark teal contours so they read clearly against orange. A small cream inset at the lower corner carries the single crisp dark numeral "1" as the strength, well separated from the seeds. No other text.
A compact chunky softly rounded triangle, seen directly from above with just a thin cardboard bevel and subtle contact shadow. Broad stable silhouette, easy to recognise at tabletop size. The result must feel like a printed physical board-game token, not a glossy app button or living seeds. Warm ivory opaque background, one complete token large in the centre, generous margin. Preserve the approved flat goofy cartoon visual family. No ducks, boards, alternatives, titles, logos or extra objects.
